reconcile.note: Gill attributes Bani's numeric and name shift to the Babylon roster predating deaths, defections, and later arrivals recorded in the Jerusalem roster.

discrepancy.note: Paine held up Ezra's and Nehemiah's family rosters as unreliable, noting the family counts differ between the two lists.

quotes.text: Nehemiah, in like manner, gives a list of the returned families, and of the number of each family. He begins as in Ezra, by saying (vii. 8): "The children of Parosh, two thousand three hundred and seventy-two;" and so on through all the families. (The list differs in several of the particulars from that of Ezra.)
quotes.attr: Thomas Paine (d. 1809), The Age of Reason, Part II (1795), ch. on Ezra, on Ezra 2 and Nehemiah 7.
